name: badass_bitch_since_year
description:
Ever felt like you’ve been navigating life’s glorious dumpster fires and still managed to look fabulous since before "adulting" was a trendy hashtag? Like you’ve spent decades perfecting the art of the strategic eye-roll, the power glance, and the 'don't mess with me' aura, often simultaneously? We thought so.

Introducing our "Badass Bitch Since 1983" candle – a fragrant tribute to the legends who've been expertly kicking ass for decades. Crafted from 100% natural soy wax and infused with our unapologetically bold scents, this isn't just a candle; it's a high-five in wax form to your unwavering resilience and impeccable taste.

This candle is a reminder that you've earned every bit of your legendary status, a beacon celebrating your humor, your strength, and your unwavering ability to get sh*t done. So, pour yourself a drink, light this beauty, and let your inner badass bask in the glow you've more than earned.
